bypassConfig.bypassAll: Enable/Disable all hardware requirement bypasses at once
bypassConfig.bypassTPM: Bypass the Trusted Platform Module (TPM) 2.0 requirement
bypassConfig.enableBypass: Unlock or lock all hardware requirement checks bypass

diskPartConfig.disableBitLocker: Enable to disable BitLocker during installation. Recommended when changing disk partitions.
diskPartConfig.diskID: Specify the Disk ID to apply the Disk & Partition Configuration
diskPartConfig.enableAutoDiskPart: Enable to automatically create/modify disk partitions based on following configurations\nDisable to manually configure disks and partitions while setting up Windows
diskPartConfig.enableDiskPart: Unlock or lock all options in the Disk & Partition Configurations section
diskPartConfig.partitionLayout: Select the partition layout to create on the disk

partitionTable.active: Whether the partition is marked as active (Yes/No)
partitionTable.format: File system format of the partition (NTFS, FAT32, etc.)
partitionTable.letter: Drive letter assigned to the partition
partitionTable.name: Name of the partition
partitionTable.quickCreate: Quick create a default partition table
partitionTable.reset: Reset the partition table (clear all partitions)
partitionTable.size: Size of the partition in megabytes
partitionTable.type: Type of the partition (Primary, Extended, Logical, Recovery, EFI, MSR)

diskPartConfig.useRemainingSpace: Enable to use all remaining disk space for the last partition in the table
diskPartConfig.wipeDisk: Enable to wipe the entire disk before partitioning. This will delete all data.

generalConfig.cpuArch: Select the CPU architecture for installation.
generalConfig.enableGeneral: Unlock or lock all options in the General Configurations section
generalConfig.productKey: Enter Product Key to activate Windows.\nLeave it blank to skip activation, or to activate with embedded key.
generalConfig.windowsEdition: Select the Windows edition to install

langRegConfig.enableLangReg: Unlock or lock all options in the Language & Region Configurations section
langRegConfig.sameAsSystemLocale: Set the User Locale same as the System Locale.\n Difference between System Locale and User Locale may break Windows Installation.
langRegConfig.systemLocale: Select the system locale for the Windows.
langRegConfig.userLocale: Select the user locale for the Windows.

mainForm.newInstallation: Switch to Upgrade Only mode (shows only Bypass and OOBE sections)
mainForm.preset: Load/Save a preset of current configurations
mainForm.upgradeOnly: Switch to New Installation mode (shows all configuration sections)

oobeConfig.enableOobe: Unlock or lock all options in the OOBE Configurations section
oobeConfig.networkLocation: Set the initial network location profile.\nHome/Work: Private firewall profile (allows network discovery).\nPublic: Public firewall profile (blocks network discovery).
oobeConfig.protectYourPC: Choose privacy settings for telemetry and cloud features.\nExpress Settings: Enables cloud features and telemetry.\nPrivacy Settings: Disables most telemetry and cloud features.
oobeConfig.skipAll: Skip all Out-Of-Box Experience (OOBE) steps during Windows installation
oobeConfig.skipEULA: Skip the End User License Agreement acceptance page
oobeConfig.skipLocalAccountCreation: Skip the local account creation screen
oobeConfig.skipOnlineAccountCreation: Skip the Microsoft account sign-in screen
oobeConfig.skipWirelessNetwork: Skip wireless network setup during OOBE

personalConfig.enablePersonal: Unlock or lock all options in the Personalize Configurations section

userAccConfig.enableUserAcc: Unlock or lock all options in the User Account Configurations section

validation.invalidProductKey: Product Key must be either empty or a valid 25-character key in the format XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX.
